title: executive-daily-priorities-elena-2026-03-05
content:
Morning brain dump / working scratchpad - 2026-03-05

Top priorities (today)
- Finalize Dedicated capacity SLA language for legal review (need to accept GC's edits by EOD). TODO: check with Priya on the clause about maintenance windows.
- Prep for 10:30 product strategy sync: outline 3 rollout scenarios for Private (VPC) customers and the tradeoffs (time to onboard, compliance checklist, support footprint).
- Spin up quick postmortem notes for last night's outage for SRE thread — short timeline + action items.

Weekly goals (this week)
- Ship first pass of Redwood Optimize beta to 3 pilot customers (MVP metrics: 10% token-cost reduction w/o 5% quality drop).
- Close Dedicated enterprise pilot with Acme (final contract comments pending).
- Approve hiring scorecard for Senior Platform Engineer (interview loop finalization).

Meeting prep / talking points
10:30 Product strategy sync (with Lina, Tom) - Focus: Private onboarding options. Key ask: decide whether to offer an "accelerated onboarding" professional service (3-week) vs do-it-yourself + CS credits. Risk = resource headcount + margins. My angle: prioritize a high-margin pilot for 2 customers, keep DIY docs for others.

12:00 Exec check-in (weekly) - Quick wins to highlight: improved 99th-pct latency on hosted API after kernel selector tweak; completed SOC-2 audit prep checklist. Issues to flag: capacity bump cost pressure for Dedicated next quarter.

2:00 SRE / Incident review - Goal: get alignment on RCA draft and immediate mitigations (better fallback routing, capacity buffers). Ask SRE to commit to runbook update by Fri.

Action items / follow-ups (short list)
- Email legal: confirm acceptance or counter for SLA draft. (Assigned to me)
- Ping Maya: confirm pilot customer list for Optimize beta. (Maya)
- Review Acme contract redlines; mark any non-standard items. (Jordan)
- Ask infra to estimate 99p latency cost delta for Dedicated scale +10% traffic. (SRE/Infra)
- Create one-pager for accelerated onboarding offering (for sales) — deadline Thu EOD. (Solutions Eng)

Notes to self / rough ideas
- Consider offering a tiered Dedicated: "standard" (no guaranteed latency) vs "premium" (SLA, reserved performance) — pricing anchor?
- Quick experiment: enable prefix KV-cache for 10% of requests on Hosted API for 48h and measure tokens saved + lat change. Low-risk toggle.
- Need to get better at baking quality metrics into Optimize recommendations (automated evals per prompt-set). Follow-up with Applied ML on next week.

Open questions / unresolved
- Is legal comfortable with 4-hour maintenance windows as a standard? (ask GC)
- Can sales commit to the onboarding fee for first two pilot customers? (risk: long procurement cycles)

Clipped notes / things to drop into docs
- "SLA language: scheduled maint windows must be notified 7 days prior, emergency maint limited to 4 hours with customer opt-out clause." (draft)
- Quick bullet for postmortem: "09:18 UTC — degraded routing due to kernel selector regression; fallback policy misconfigured for model-variant mapping; fix deployed 09:42; follow-up: add unit test + canary for selector change."

Misc / personal
- Block 4-5pm for deep work (try to protect).
- Bring up the onboarding fee discussion with Sales lead in Friday 1:1.

---
Document is rough — moving items to Confluence and JIRA after meetings. Keep this as working scratchpad.

References / links to followups:
- Confluence: confluence:leadership-weekly-2026-03
- Jira: LEAD-1982 (SLA draft); INFRA-3459 (incident)
- Slack: #exec-ops-thread — thread about Dedicated pricing

(End of scratchpad)
